title: Build from my business never waits on photo labelling, says when it reads the business, and keeps unchanged reads and looks across checks
steps: S1: label five pictures one per call, two calls at once, and answer the second call before the first.

S2: ask a brief's photo labelling run for its answer while it labels, after it settles, and past its five-minute bound; ask revisionForAction for an own-site brief while its run still labels, then after.
S3: follow a business whose chat/prepare answers DEMO_PICTURE_LABELS_PENDING twice; read the research progress of a job whose progress says reading: business.
S4: make the business reading's door from a DeepSeek assignment set to high, and from a provider whose reasoning cannot be turned off.
S5: ask whether a kept page read stands for a finding when the page is static, dynamic, or of unknown kind.
S6: look at two pages in one stream where the second vision call fails.
expect: S1: the third call starts as soon as the second answers, while the first is still out.

S2: pending with a time to ask again and no brief written while it labels; the settled labels once done, from one labelling call; a failed labelling with reason labelling_overdue and no label past the bound.
S3: prepare is asked again after each pending answer with the photos line shown, then the chat opens; the progress names reading and no source.
S4: effort off with a 4,000-token answer budget for DeepSeek; no effort and 12,000 tokens for the other provider.
S5: only the static page's read is kept.
S6: the first page counts as seen; the second is unlooked on its phone width.
evidence: Issues 250, 251 and 247 (dev 30/10/2026, Zuni Cafe): chat/prepare 113 s, profile stage 119.7 s with no progress, checks of 9-28 min with every incremental read 0 unchanged and every look partly with 0 pages seen

cmd: --test-name-pattern=a bounded pool|one run per input|a run still out past its bound|revisionForAction answers pending|a chat whose photos are still being labelled|while the research reads the business it says so|a reading asks for no reasoning|a finding keeps a read whose fingerprint|a page is seen once every tile
tests: a bounded pool: the next batch starts as soon as any call answers
one run per input: pending while it labels, its settled answer after, asked once
a run still out past its bound is an honest failed labelling, never a longer wait
revisionForAction answers pending and makes no brief while the photographs are labelled, then briefs them
a chat whose photos are still being labelled is asked again, with its own line, never failed
researchProgressOf: while the research reads the business it says so, and names no source left behind
a reading asks for no reasoning where the provider can turn it off, and a JSON-sized answer
a finding keeps a read whose fingerprint holds the whole page; a dynamic or unknown one is read anew
a page is seen once every tile of it is answered, even when a later call of its stream fails
